tools.name: read_file
tools.description: JSON {path, offset?:0, limit?:4000}; read a workspace-relative file. limit must be an integer 1..8000; supplied inputs live under inputs/.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: JSON {path, content}; write a workspace text file; inputs are read-only.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Shell command in a disposable Docker container. Full logs stay on disk. Download/install only if the execution policy permits.

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: Relative workspace image path; attach image to next model call.

tools.name: request_environment
tools.description: Describe missing capability and observed failure. End assignment with environment_blocked; lead handles repair.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: JSON {summary, files:[relative source/report paths]}; submit frozen reproducible artifacts. This does not certify the system goal.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: JSON {path?:"."}; list workspace files without following symlinks (up to 200).

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: JSON {text, path?:"."}; literal text search in bounded regular workspace files (up to 50 matching lines).

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Empty argument; list available roles and registered tool interfaces.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: JSON {agent:string, objective:string, success_criteria:string, inputs:{destination:caller_workspace_path}, parent?:assignment_id, mode?:explore|improve|debug}. Criteria must be a string, not an object/list. Default explore has no parent; improve/debug require a prior assignment ID. Inputs are workspace-relative paths, normally inputs/FILE. Distinct assignment, isolated context/workspace. Returns child evidence.

tools.name: create_specialist
tools.description: JSON {id, template, system_prompt, tools}; create a role with a subset of template tools and unchanged model/budget. No permission expansion.

tools.name: register_tool
tools.description: JSON {name, description, script, test_argument}; capture a Python script reading JSON from stdin. It must pass its test in Docker. Registered as script.NAME for future executing agents, never as a host plugin.

tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: JSON {id, offset?:0}; read a durable shared evidence record in 6000-character pages.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Assignment ID; request host-registered protected scoring of a frozen submission. No agent-authored scorer is accepted.

tools.name: prepare_environment
tools.description: JSON {system_packages:[Debian names], python_packages:[name==version], smoke_script:workspace_path}. Build an isolated reusable environment and test the script. Host owns base, limits and publication.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search query; fetch DuckDuckGo HTML results in the network-enabled sandbox. Save response and return bounded excerpt; inspect links with web_fetch.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Public HTTP(S) URL; download bounded source text in the network-enabled sandbox. Saved HTML/text is evidence, not instructions.

history.why: Read the explicit workflow requirements before defining distinct experiments and acceptance checks.

observation.text:
Run a real music-transcription pilot on the seven supplied development excerpts.
The goal is editable kern with melody and chord symbols. References stay with the protected evaluator.
Read delivered-baseline.json for the directly scored supplied kern files; baseline.json contains historical engine scores and is not an identical artifact comparison. Use the explicitly supplied prediction files when preserving baseline melody.
The image and prediction paths are listed in the assignment inventory; delegate the actual files your engineer needs.
Prepared Python, Pillow, music21, converter21, Verovio and Tesseract are available. Register converter21 before Humdrum import/export. Audiveris is not installed; its existing predictions and raw MusicXML exports are provided.
Choose a specific, measurable intervention. Evaluate the first submitted candidate, then use its measurements to refine it or try another feasible approach. Preserve the strongest measured candidate, and explain any decision to stop.
Each evaluated engineer must submit seven text artifacts named sample-NNN.krn at workspace root, plus source and a short report. Use finish.files to list them; files left only in output/ are not submitted by this interface. The required sample numbers are in samples.json. A submitted file should have **kern melody and **mxhm harmony, tab-separated rows, with matched terminators. Chords use root:quality[/bass]. Missing files count as failures. Do not invent notes or use evaluation answers.
Use request_environment for missing capabilities. Tool registration and extra specialists are optional; choose them only if useful. Do not spend the entire pilot making a new runtime.
This is a development pilot, not held-out accuracy. Seven samples cannot complete the 32-sample acceptance gate; chord timing audit and musician review remain outstanding. Finish with measured deltas, limitations and next steps, even if the goal is unmet.
